metadata.article_title: Prevention of injury to public property

article.title: Prevention of injury to public property
article.content: A police officer may of his own authority interpose to prevent any injury attempted to be committed in his view to any public property, movable or immovable, or the removal or injury of any public landmark, buoy or other mark used for navigation.
article.html:
171Prevention of injury to public property

Section 171 · Chapter XII

A police officer may of his own authority interpose to prevent any injury attempted to be committed in his view to any public property, movable or immovable, or the removal or injury of any public landmark, buoy or other mark used for navigation.
